## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem you're trying to solve. e.g. "I want to install MCP servers on multiple machines at once."

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see. e.g. "Add a `mcp-hub install-all` command that reads a list of servers from a file."

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've considered.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other tools, etc.
